sources.title: JSON Schema Validation: A Vocabulary for Structural Validation of JSON
sources.publicationStatus: Published Internet-Draft/work in progress; not an IETF RFC
sources.shortExcerpt: Structural validation alone may be insufficient to allow an application to correctly utilize certain values.
sources.notes: The format vocabulary addresses defined semantic formats. Validation behavior depends on vocabulary and implementation; this is not validation of arbitrary natural-language entailment.

sources.title: PROV-Overview
sources.publicationStatus: W3C Working Group Note; non-normative overview
sources.shortExcerpt: which can be used to form assessments about its quality, reliability or trustworthiness
sources.notes: Describes provenance as information for assessment and interchange. Shares its standards family with E-003; these are not independent empirical corroborations.

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.shortExcerpt: provenance is also regarded as an entity (of type Bundle)
sources.notes: Names entities/activities/agents and describes provenance of provenance, including attribution and generation time. The cited conceptual overview is informative rather than the normative type definitions.
